description: This file contains PHP classes for managing MySQL database connections, executing queries, and handling record sets, including support for lazy connections, error handling, and pagination.

classes.name: MySQLConnection
classes.description: Encapsulates a lazy-connection to a MySQL database, providing methods for connecting, disconnecting, error handling, and creating record objects.

classes.name: MySqlRecord
classes.description: Represents a record for insert, update, or delete operations on a MySQL database, with methods for building SQL statements and executing them.

classes.name: MySqlRecordSet
classes.description: Handles the result set of a SELECT query, supporting iteration, pagination, and total row count retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with configuration or connection object.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the active database connection resource, establishing it if necessary.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the MySQL database.

methods.name: RaiseError
methods.description: Handles database errors by passing error info to the framework.

methods.name: makeLiteral
methods.description: Converts a PHP value into an SQL literal string.

methods.name: NewRecord
methods.description: Creates a new record object, optionally initialized with a DataSpace.

methods.name: NewRecordSet
methods.description: Creates a new record set for a query, with optional filtering.

methods.name: NewPagedRecordSet
methods.description: Creates a paginated record set for a query.

methods.name: FindRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single record matching a query.

methods.name: getOneValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single value from a query.

methods.name: getOneColumnArray
methods.description: Retrieves an array of first-column values from a query.

methods.name: getTwoColumnArray
methods.description: Retrieves an associative array from a query with first column as key and second as value.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query that does not return a result set.

methods.name: _execute
methods.description: Internal method to execute a SQL query and return the result resource.
